records.jp: ねえ、愛央。<CR>ちょっといいかしら？
records.en_original: Ao, do you have a moment?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, do you have a moment?
records.en: Hey, Ao.<CR>Do you have a moment?

records.jp: うん、いいよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, sure!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, sure!
records.en: Yeah, sure!

records.jp: よかった。なら、少し歩かない？
records.en_original: Wonderful. Let's go for a walk.
records.en_auxiliary: Wonderful. Let's go for a walk.
records.en: Wonderful. Let's go for a walk.

records.jp: え、お散歩？<CR>美弦さんから誘ってもらえるなんて、嬉しい！
records.en_original: A walk? I'm so happy that you'd invite me!
records.en_auxiliary: A walk? I'm so happy that you'd invite me!
records.en: A walk?<CR>I'm happy that you invited me, Mio-san!

records.jp: 大げさね。<CR>でも、そう言ってもらえると私も嬉しいわ
records.en_original: You're overreacting. But still, I'm glad to hear that.
records.en_auxiliary: You're overreacting. But still, I'm glad to hear that.
records.en: You're exaggerating.<CR>But hearing you say that makes me happy too.

records.jp: 実は相談したいことがあって……
records.en_original: Actually, I wanted your advice on something...
records.en_auxiliary: Actually, I wanted your advice on something...
records.en: Actually, I wanted your advice on something...

records.jp: なになに？　何でも聞いてよ！
records.en_original: Ooh, what is it? You can ask me anything!
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, what is it? You can ask me anything!
records.en: Ooh, what is it? You can ask me anything!

records.jp: その……最近陽桜莉がね、冷たいの
records.en_original: It's just... Hiori's been a bit cold lately.
records.en_auxiliary: It's just... Hiori's been a bit cold lately.
records.en: Well... Hiori has been cold toward me lately.

records.jp: あの陽桜莉さんが……！？<CR>何か怒らせるようなことしたの？
records.en_original: Hiori has? That's unusual... Is she mad about something?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori has? That's unusual... Is she mad about something?
records.en: Hiori-san, of all people...!?<CR>Did you do something to make her angry?

records.jp: 私はそんなつもりはなかったのだけど、<CR>あの子が言うには……
records.en_original: She says that she doesn't mean to be, but...
records.en_auxiliary: She says that she doesn't mean to be, but...
records.en: I didn't mean to do anything,<CR>but according to her...

records.jp: 陽桜莉、洗濯物あったりする？<CR>まとめて洗っておくわ
records.en_original: Hiori, do you have any dirty laundry? I'm gathering everything to wash.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori, do you have any dirty laundry? I'm gathering everything to wash.
records.en: Hiori, do you have any laundry?<CR>I'll wash it all together.

records.jp: あー、大丈夫だよ！　後で自分で洗うから
records.en_original: Nah, it's fine! I'll do my own later.
records.en_auxiliary: Nah, it's fine! I'll do my own later.
records.en: Nah, it's fine! I'll do my own later.

records.jp: お布団とか、汚れてない？<CR>おなか空いてたりとか……
records.en_original: How about your sheets? Are you hungry at all?
records.en_auxiliary: How about your sheets? Are you hungry at all?
records.en: Are your sheets dirty?<CR>Or are you hungry...?

records.jp: 大丈夫だって！　もう、気にしすぎだよ！
records.en_original: I said I'm fine! Jeez, you're such a nag!
records.en_auxiliary: I said I'm fine! Jeez, you're such a nag!
records.en: I said I'm fine! Jeez, you're such a nag!

records.jp: お姉ちゃんちょっと過保護すぎ！<CR>もっと妹離れしなきゃ！
records.en_original: You're way too overprotective, Mio! You've got to give me some space!
records.en_auxiliary: You're way too overprotective, Mio! You've got to give me some space!
records.en: You're much too overprotective, Onee-chan!<CR>You need to learn to let go of your younger sister!

records.jp: でも、陽桜莉にはいろいろ迷惑かけたし……。<CR>少しでも報いたいのよ
records.en_original: But... I've caused you so much trouble, I want to make it up to you.
records.en_auxiliary: But... I've caused you so much trouble, I want to make it up to you.
records.en: But I've caused Hiori all kinds of trouble...<CR>I want to repay her, even if only a little.

records.jp: そんなの気にしないの。<CR>とにかく、お姉ちゃんは私以外にも目を向けるべきだよ
records.en_original: You don't need to worry about that so much. There are other people here who could use your help more than me.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't need to worry about that so much. There are other people here who could use your help more than me.
records.en: Don't worry about that.<CR>Anyway, you should pay attention to people besides me too, Onee-chan.

records.jp: ということで、これからしばらく必要な時以外<CR>私に話しかけないこと！
records.en_original: So let's do this. No talking to me unless absolutely necessary!
records.en_auxiliary: So let's do this. No talking to me unless absolutely necessary!
records.en: So, for a while from now on,<CR>don't talk to me unless it's necessary!

records.jp: ええっ！
records.en_original: What?!
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: ……なるほど、過保護かあ
records.en_original: Overprotective, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Overprotective, huh...
records.en: Overprotective, huh...

records.jp: 美弦さんにこんなに世話してもらえるなんて、<CR>私なら嬉しいけどなあ
records.en_original: Honestly, I'd love it if you looked after me like that.
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I'd love it if you looked after me like that.
records.en: I'd be happy<CR>if Mio-san took this much care of me.

records.jp: それ以来、陽桜莉からもあんまり声を<CR>かけてくれなくなってしまって……
records.en_original: Hiori has barely spoken a word to me since then...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori has barely spoken a word to me since then...
records.en: Ever since then, Hiori has hardly<CR>spoken to me either...

records.jp: いくら何でも極端だと思わない？
records.en_original: Don't you think this is a bit cruel?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you think this is a bit cruel?
records.en: Don't you think this is a bit cruel?

records.jp: あはは、陽桜莉さんらしいかな。<CR>思い立ったら一直線、というか
records.en_original: Haha, it sounds exactly like what Hiori would do. She's got a bit of a one-track mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, it sounds exactly like what Hiori would do. She's got a bit of a one-track mind.
records.en: Ahaha, that does sound like Hiori-san.<CR>Once she decides something, she charges straight ahead.

records.jp: それ、陽桜莉を馬鹿にしてる？
records.en_original: Are you making fun of Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you making fun of Hiori?
records.en: Are you making fun of Hiori?

records.jp: えっ！？　してないしてない！
records.en_original: Huh? No way! Not at all!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? No way! Not at all!
records.en: Huh? No way! Not at all!

records.jp: びっくりしたなあ、もう。<CR>そういうところが過保護だって言われるんだよ
records.en_original: Don't scare me like that... That's exactly what Hiori means when she says you're overprotective.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't scare me like that... That's exactly what Hiori means when she says you're overprotective.
records.en: You startled me, geez.<CR>That's exactly the kind of thing she calls overprotective.

records.en_original: Hmph...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph...
records.en: Hmph...

records.jp: まあ、事情はなんとなく分かったかな。<CR>つまり相談というのは……
records.en_original: Well, I think I understand the situation now. What did you want my advice on?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I think I understand the situation now. What did you want my advice on?
records.en: Well, I think I understand the situation.<CR>So what you wanted advice about was...

records.jp: 陽桜莉をあきらめさせる方法
records.en_original: How do you think I can get Hiori to stop this?
records.en_auxiliary: How do you think I can get Hiori to stop this?
records.en: How to make Hiori give up on this.

records.jp: そうきたか……。<CR>妹離れの努力はしない？
records.en_original: I thought you'd say that... Maybe she's right. This may be a good chance to wean yourself off her.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you'd say that... Maybe she's right. This may be a good chance to wean yourself off her.
records.en: So that's your answer...<CR>You won't try to let go of your younger sister?

records.jp: ……そんなの、どうすればいいのかわからないもの
records.en_original: ...I don't know how I would possibly go about that.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I don't know how I would possibly go about that.
records.en: ...I don't know how I would possibly go about that.

records.jp: 急に私のすることがなくなってしまって。<CR>ぼーっとしている時間も増えた気がする
records.en_original: Suddenly, there's nothing for me to do anymore. I have all of this extra time.
records.en_auxiliary: Suddenly, there's nothing for me to do anymore. I have all of this extra time.
records.en: Suddenly I have nothing to do.<CR>I feel as though I spend more time staring into space.

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: じゃあ、陽桜莉さんの代わりを<CR>見つけるっていうのはどう？
records.en_original: Then why not find someone to take care of instead of Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: Then why not find someone to take care of instead of Hiori?
records.en: Then how about finding<CR>someone to take Hiori-san's place?

records.jp: 陽桜莉の代わりを？
records.en_original: Someone other than Hiori...?
records.en_auxiliary: Someone other than Hiori...?
records.en: Someone to take Hiori's place?

records.jp: そう！　誰かをお世話することで、<CR>ぼーっとすることもなくなると思うし
records.en_original: Yeah! You won't be bored if you're taking care of them.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! You won't be bored if you're taking care of them.
records.en: Right! If you're taking care of someone,<CR>you won't have time to sit around spacing out.

records.jp: その人に使う時間が増えれば、<CR>自然と陽桜莉さんからも離れることにならないかな？
records.en_original: And the more time you spend with them, the more time you'll spend away from Hiori, right?
records.en_auxiliary: And the more time you spend with them, the more time you'll spend away from Hiori, right?
records.en: And if you spend more time on that person,<CR>wouldn't you naturally spend more time apart from Hiori-san?

records.jp: なるほど……一理あるかもしれない
records.en_original: Hmm... I suppose you do have a point.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I suppose you do have a point.
records.en: Hmm... I suppose you do have a point.

records.jp: ということで、ほらほら！<CR>ここにお世話してほしそうな人がいるよ！
records.en_original: And, hey! You have a person who totally wants to be taken care of right here!
records.en_auxiliary: And, hey! You have a person who totally wants to be taken care of right here!
records.en: And on that note, look, look!<CR>Here's someone who looks like she wants you to take care of her!

records.jp: ……あははー、まあ別に私じゃなくても……
records.en_original: Ahaha... Well, it doesn't have to be me...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... Well, it doesn't have to be me...
records.en: ...Ahaha. Well, it doesn't necessarily have to be me...

records.jp: わかった。その提案に乗ってみましょう
records.en_original: All right. I'll try your idea.
records.en_auxiliary: All right. I'll try your idea.
records.en: All right. I'll try your idea.

records.jp: え、いいの？
records.en_original: Huh? Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Really?
records.en: Huh? Really?

records.jp: ええ。相談に乗ってもらったお礼もしたいから
records.en_original: Yes. I'd like to repay you for hearing me out as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I'd like to repay you for hearing me out as well.
records.en: Yes. I also want to thank you for hearing me out.

records.jp: これからよろしくね、愛央
records.en_original: Thank you for your help today.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for your help today.
records.en: Then I'll be looking after you from now on, Ao.

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>フラッシュボム<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Flash Bomb<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Flash Bomb<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Flash Bomb<CLNR> memory.
